name: [🎨] Hide In Pixels
desc:
Welcome to Hide In Pixels! 👾

Blend into the pixels and don't get spotted! 🎨 Every round you get a giant pixel-art painting. Paint your character block by block to match the picture, then freeze and hope nobody finds you. 🕵️

⚔️ Go head to head against another player. Whoever blends in best wins the round. First to win 2 rounds wins the whole game! 🏆

🔥 Build up your win streak
💥 Troll your opponent with jumpscares, flash bangs, screen shakes and more
🖼️ Tons of pixel paintings to hide in

👍 LIKE + JOIN GROUP 👍

Our Game Supports
💻 PC | 🎮 Console | 📱 Mobile

Invite your friends for even more fun! 🤗
Play with friends for FREE on our free private servers! 🎮

This game is inspired by Mecca Chameleon.

scripts.script:
--========================================================
-- PIXEL CAMOUFLAGE + ESP CHAMELEON
-- Modern Professional UI | R6 / R15
-- Client-side LocalScript
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--========================================================
-- CONFIGURATION
--========================================================

local FIGURE_NAMES = {
    PixelFigure = true,
    PaintDummy = true,
}

local PAINTING_NAME = "PixelPainting"
local BLOCK_NAME = "Block"
local BODY_NAME = "Body"

local ESP_MODEL_PATH = {
    "ChameleonOpponent",
    "Figure",
}

local MAX_PLANE_DISTANCE = 8

local ESP_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
local ESP_FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.15
local ESP_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY = 0

--========================================================
-- UI THEME
--========================================================

local THEME = {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 29),
    Surface = Color3.fromRGB(25, 29, 43),
    SurfaceLight = Color3.fromRGB(34, 39, 56),

    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(139, 92, 246),
    AccentLight = Color3.fromRGB(167, 139, 250),
    Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191),

    Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 255),
    Muted = Color3.fromRGB(155, 165, 187),

    Green = Color3.fromRGB(16, 185, 129),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(239, 83, 103),

    Border = Color3.fromRGB(57, 64, 86),
}

--========================================================
-- STATE
--========================================================

local originalAppearance = {}
local paintedParts = {}
local espHighlight

local espEnabled = false
local draggingEnabled = true
local panelVisible = true

local screenGui
local mainFrame
local statusLabel
local espButton
local camouflageButton
local hideButton
local showButton

local espConnection
local dragConnection

--========================================================
-- HELPERS
--========================================================

local function isBasePart(instance)
    return instance and instance:IsA("BasePart")
end

local function getAllParts(root)
    local result = {}

    if not root then
        return result
    end

    for _, instance in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function getNamedParts(root, wantedName)
    local result = {}

    if not root then
        return result
    end

    for _, instance in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("BasePart")
            and instance.Name == wantedName then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function findNamedModels()
    local result = {}

    for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("Model")
            and FIGURE_NAMES[instance.Name] then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function getPaintings()
    local result = {}

    for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("Model")
            and instance.Name == PAINTING_NAME then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function setStatus(message)
    if statusLabel and statusLabel.Parent then
        statusLabel.Text = message
    end
end

--========================================================
-- SAVE AND RESTORE ORIGINAL APPEARANCE
--========================================================

local function saveOriginal(part)
    if originalAppearance[part] then
        return
    end

    local data = {
        Color = part.Color,
        Material = part.Material,
        MaterialVariant = part.MaterialVariant,
        TextureObjects = {},
    }

    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("Decal") then
            data.TextureObjects[child] = {
                Color3 = child.Color3,
                Transparency = child.Transparency,
            }
        end
    end

    originalAppearance[part] = data
end

local function paintBody(part, color)
    if not isBasePart(part) or not part.Parent then
        return
    end

    saveOriginal(part)

    part.Color = color
    part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("Decal") then
            child.Color3 = color
        end
    end

    paintedParts[part] = true
end

local function restoreAll()
    for part, data in pairs(originalAppearance) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            part.Color = data.Color
            part.Material = data.Material

            pcall(function()
                part.MaterialVariant = data.MaterialVariant
            end)

            for texture, textureData in pairs(data.TextureObjects) do
                if texture and texture.Parent == part then
                    texture.Color3 = textureData.Color3
                    texture.Transparency = textureData.Transparency
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.clear(originalAppearance)
    table.clear(paintedParts)
end

--========================================================
-- PROJECT PART INTO PAINTING SPACE
--========================================================

local function getProjectedBounds(part, paintingCFrame)
    local half = part.Size * 0.5

    local minX, maxX = math.huge, -math.huge
    local minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge
    local minZ, maxZ = math.huge, -math.huge

    for _, sx in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
        for _, sy in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
            for _, sz in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                local cornerLocal = Vector3.new(
                    half.X * sx,
                    half.Y * sy,
                    half.Z * sz
                )

                local cornerWorld =
                    part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(cornerLocal)

                local p =
                    paintingCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(cornerWorld)

                minX = math.min(minX, p.X)
                maxX = math.max(maxX, p.X)
                minY = math.min(minY, p.Y)
                maxY = math.max(maxY, p.Y)
                minZ = math.min(minZ, p.Z)
                maxZ = math.max(maxZ, p.Z)
            end
        end
    end

    return {
        minX = minX,
        maxX = maxX,
        minY = minY,
        maxY = maxY,
        minZ = minZ,
        maxZ = maxZ,
        centerZ = (minZ + maxZ) * 0.5,
        width = maxX - minX,
        height = maxY - minY,
    }
end

--========================================================
-- RECTANGLE OVERLAP
--========================================================

local function getOverlapArea(a, b)
    local overlapX = math.max(
        0,
        math.min(a.maxX, b.maxX)
            - math.max(a.minX, b.minX)
    )

    local overlapY = math.max(
        0,
        math.min(a.maxY, b.maxY)
            - math.max(a.minY, b.minY)
    )

    return overlapX * overlapY
end

local function getPlaneGap(a, b)
    if a.maxZ < b.minZ then
        return b.minZ - a.maxZ
    elseif b.maxZ < a.minZ then
        return a.minZ - b.maxZ
    end

    return 0
end

--========================================================
-- FIND RELEVANT PAINTING
--========================================================

local function findPaintingForFigure(figure, paintings)
    local figureParts = getNamedParts(figure, BODY_NAME)

    if #figureParts == 0 then
        figureParts = getAllParts(figure)
    end

    if #figureParts == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local figureCenter = figure:GetPivot().Position
    local bestPainting = nil
    local bestDistance = math.huge

    for _, painting in ipairs(paintings) do
        local blocks = getNamedParts(painting, BLOCK_NAME)

        if #blocks > 0 then
            local nearest = math.huge

            for _, block in ipairs(blocks) do
                local distance =
                    (block.Position - figureCenter).Magnitude

                if distance < nearest then
                    nearest = distance
                end
            end

            if nearest < bestDistance then
                bestDistance = nearest
                bestPainting = painting
            end
        end
    end

    return bestPainting
end

--========================================================
-- BUILD PIXEL DATA
--========================================================

local function buildPixelGrid(painting)
    local pixels = {}
    local paintingCFrame = painting:GetPivot()

    for _, block in ipairs(getNamedParts(painting, BLOCK_NAME)) do
        table.insert(pixels, {
            part = block,
            color = block.Color,
            bounds = getProjectedBounds(block, paintingCFrame),
        })
    end

    return pixels, paintingCFrame
end

--========================================================
-- CHOOSE PIXEL BY ACTUAL OVERLAP
--========================================================

local function findBestPixel(body, pixels, paintingCFrame)
    local bodyBounds = getProjectedBounds(body, paintingCFrame)

    local bestPixel = nil
    local bestArea = 0
    local bestGap = math.huge

    for _, pixel in ipairs(pixels) do
        local blockBounds = pixel.bounds
        local gap = getPlaneGap(bodyBounds, blockBounds)

        if gap <= MAX_PLANE_DISTANCE then
            local area = getOverlapArea(bodyBounds, blockBounds)

            if area > bestArea then
                bestArea = area
                bestGap = gap
                bestPixel = pixel

            elseif area > 0
                and math.abs(area - bestArea) < 0.0001
                and gap < bestGap then
                bestGap = gap
                bestPixel = pixel
            end
        end
    end

    if bestArea <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    return bestPixel
end

--========================================================
-- APPLY CAMOUFLAGE
--========================================================

local function applyCamouflage()
    local figures = findNamedModels()
    local paintings = getPaintings()

    if #figures == 0 then
        setStatus("No PixelFigure/PaintDummy found")
        return
    end

    if #paintings == 0 then
        setStatus("No PixelPainting found")
        return
    end

    local paintedCount = 0
    local unmatchedCount = 0

    for _, figure in ipairs(figures) do
        local painting =
            findPaintingForFigure(figure, paintings)

        if painting then
            local pixels, paintingCFrame =
                buildPixelGrid(painting)

            local bodies = getNamedParts(figure, BODY_NAME)

            for _, body in ipairs(bodies) do
                if body.Transparency < 1 then
                    local pixel = findBestPixel(
                        body,
                        pixels,
                        paintingCFrame
                    )

                    if pixel then
                        paintBody(body, pixel.color)
                        paintedCount += 1
                    else
                        unmatchedCount += 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    setStatus(
        "Applied: " .. paintedCount
        .. " | No overlap: " .. unmatchedCount
    )
end

--========================================================
-- ESP CHAMELEON
--========================================================

local function findESPTarget()
    local current = workspace

    for _, name in ipairs(ESP_MODEL_PATH) do
        current = current:FindFirstChild(name)

        if not current then
            return nil
        end
    end

    return current
end

local function removeESP()
    if espHighlight then
        espHighlight:Destroy()
        espHighlight = nil
    end
end

local function updateESP()
    if not espEnabled then
        removeESP()
        return
    end

    local target = findESPTarget()

    if not target then
        removeESP()
        return
    end

    if espHighlight and espHighlight.Parent ~= target then
        removeESP()
    end

    if not espHighlight then
        espHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        espHighlight.Name = "PixelCamouflageESP"
        espHighlight.Adornee = target
        espHighlight.Parent = target
    end

    espHighlight.Enabled = true
    espHighlight.FillColor = ESP_COLOR
    espHighlight.OutlineColor = ESP_COLOR
    espHighlight.FillTransparency = ESP_FILL_TRANSPARENCY
    espHighlight.OutlineTransparency = ESP_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY
    espHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
end

--========================================================
-- UI HELPERS
--========================================================

local function addCorner(object, radius)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    corner.Parent = object
    return corner
end

local function addStroke(object, color, thickness, transparency)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = color
    stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
    stroke.Transparency = transparency or 0
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Parent = object
    return stroke
end

local function addGradient(object, colorA, colorB, rotation)
    local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, colorA),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, colorB),
    })
    gradient.Rotation = rotation or 0
    gradient.Parent = object
    return gradient
end

local function makeLabel(
    parent,
    name,
    text,
    size,
    position,
    color,
    font,
    textSize
)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = name
    label.Size = size
    label.Position = position
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = color
    label.Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham
    label.TextSize = textSize or 13
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    label.Parent = parent

    return label
end

--========================================================
-- UI CREATION
--========================================================

local function createUI()
    local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PixelCamouflageUI")

    if old then
        old:Destroy()
    end

    screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Name = "PixelCamouflageUI"
    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
    screenGui.DisplayOrder = 50
    screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    screenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

    -- Main window
    mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
    mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 290, 0, 250)
    mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.32, 0)
    mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Background
    mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    mainFrame.Active = true
    mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
    mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

    addCorner(mainFrame, 16)

    -- UIStroke verde SOLO para el marco grande
    addStroke(mainFrame, THEME.Green, 2, 0)

    -- Header icon
    local logo = Instance.new("Frame")
    logo.Name = "Logo"
    logo.Size = UDim2.new(0, 39, 0, 39)
    logo.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 15)
    logo.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SurfaceLight
    logo.BorderSizePixel = 0
    logo.Parent = mainFrame

    addCorner(logo, 12)

    local logoText = makeLabel(
        logo,
        "LogoEmoji",
        "🎨",
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        THEME.Text,
        Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        22
    )

    logoText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

    -- Header text
    makeLabel(
        mainFrame,
        "Title",
        "PIXEL CAMOUFLAGE",
        UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 23),
        UDim2.new(0, 62, 0, 16),
        THEME.Text,
        Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        15
    )

    makeLabel(
        mainFrame,
        "Subtitle",
        "CAMOUFLAGE CONTROL CENTER",
        UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 17),
        UDim2.new(0, 63, 0, 38),
        THEME.Muted,
        Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        9
    )

    -- Online indicator
    local onlineDot = Instance.new("Frame")
    onlineDot.Name = "OnlineDot"
    onlineDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
    onlineDot.Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 24)
    onlineDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Cyan
    onlineDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    onlineDot.Parent = mainFrame

    addCorner(onlineDot, 10)

    -- Header divider: invisible
    local divider = Instance.new("Frame")
    divider.Name = "HeaderDivider"
    divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1)
    divider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 64)
    divider.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    divider.BorderSizePixel = 0
    divider.Parent = mainFrame

    -- Section heading
    makeLabel(
        mainFrame,
        "ActionsHeading",
        "QUICK ACTIONS",
        UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18),
        UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 72),
        THEME.Muted,
        Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        10
    )

    -- Main button factory: no text strokes
    local function makeButton(name, text, y, height, color)
        local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
        button.Name = name
        button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, height)
        button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, y)
        button.BackgroundColor3 = color
        button.BorderSizePixel = 0
        button.Text = text
        button.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
        button.TextSize = 13
        button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        button.AutoButtonColor = false
        button.TextWrapped = false
        button.Parent = mainFrame

        addCorner(button, 10)

        return button
    end

    -- Camouflage button: same normal color as ESP OFF
    camouflageButton = makeButton(
        "CamouflageApply",
        "🎨   APPLY CAMOUFLAGE",
        94,
        39,
        THEME.SurfaceLight
    )

    -- ESP button
    espButton = makeButton(
        "ESPButton",
        "ESP CHAMELEON",
        141,
        36,
        THEME.SurfaceLight
    )

    -- Status section
    local statusCard = Instance.new("Frame")
    statusCard.Name = "StatusCard"
    statusCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 37)
    statusCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 185)
    statusCard.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Surface
    statusCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
    statusCard.Parent = mainFrame

    addCorner(statusCard, 9)

    local statusDot = Instance.new("Frame")
    statusDot.Name = "StatusDot"
    statusDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6)
    statusDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -3)
    statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Cyan
    statusDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    statusDot.Parent = statusCard

    addCorner(statusDot, 10)

    statusLabel = makeLabel(
        statusCard,
        "Status",
        "Ready",
        UDim2.new(1, -27, 1, 0),
        UDim2.new(0, 21, 0, 0),
        THEME.Muted,
        Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        10
    )

    statusLabel.TextWrapped = true

    -- Hide button
    hideButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hideButton.Name = "HidePanel"
    hideButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 27, 0, 27)
    hideButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20)
    hideButton.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SurfaceLight
    hideButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hideButton.Text = "—"
    hideButton.TextColor3 = THEME.Muted
    hideButton.TextSize = 17
    hideButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    hideButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    hideButton.Parent = mainFrame

    addCorner(hideButton, 8)

    -- Footer
    makeLabel(
        mainFrame,
        "Footer",
        "PIXEL SYSTEM  •  MOBILE READY",
        UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 12),
        UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -14),
        THEME.Muted,
        Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        8
    )

    -- Floating show button: only emoji, green outline
    showButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    showButton.Name = "ShowPanel"
    showButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 48)
    showButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    showButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12)
    showButton.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Background
    showButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    showButton.Text = "🎨"
    showButton.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
    showButton.TextSize = 27
    showButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    showButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    showButton.Visible = false
    showButton.Active = true
    showButton.Parent = screenGui

    addCorner(showButton, 14)

    -- UIStroke verde SOLO para el botón 🎨
    addStroke(showButton, THEME.Green, 2, 0)

    --====================================================
    -- CAMOUFLAGE BUTTON PRESS EFFECT
    --====================================================

    local normalCamouflageColor = THEME.SurfaceLight
    local pressedCamouflageColor = THEME.Green
    local camouflagePressed = false

    local function restoreCamouflageButton()
        if not camouflageButton or not camouflageButton.Parent then
            return
        end

        camouflagePressed = false
        camouflageButton.BackgroundColor3 = normalCamouflageColor
    end

    camouflageButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            camouflagePressed = true
            camouflageButton.BackgroundColor3 = pressedCamouflageColor
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            if camouflagePressed then
                restoreCamouflageButton()
            end
        end
    end)

    camouflageButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        local originalText = camouflageButton.Text

        camouflageButton.Text = "⏳  APPLYING..."

        task.defer(function()
            local success, err = pcall(applyCamouflage)

            if not success then
                warn("[PixelCamouflage] " .. tostring(err))
                setStatus("Error applying camouflage")
            end

            if camouflageButton and camouflageButton.Parent then
                camouflageButton.Text = originalText
                restoreCamouflageButton()
            end
        end)
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- ESP SWITCH
    --====================================================

    local function refreshESPButton()
        espButton.Text = "ESP CHAMELEON"

        local oldSwitch = espButton:FindFirstChild("Switch")

        if oldSwitch then
            oldSwitch:Destroy()
        end

        local switch = Instance.new("Frame")
        switch.Name = "Switch"
        switch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 22)
        switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -53, 0.5, -11)
        switch.BorderSizePixel = 0

        switch.BackgroundColor3 = espEnabled
            and THEME.Green
            or THEME.Border

        switch.Parent = espButton

        addCorner(switch, 20)

        local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
        knob.Name = "Knob"
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)

        knob.Position = espEnabled
            and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8)
            or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)

        knob.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Text
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.Parent = switch

        addCorner(knob, 20)

        if espEnabled then
            espButton.BackgroundColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(24, 91, 79)

            espButton.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(153, 255, 222)

            updateESP()
        else
            espButton.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SurfaceLight
            espButton.TextColor3 = THEME.Text

            removeESP()
        end
    end

    espButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        espEnabled = not espEnabled
        refreshESPButton()
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- HIDE / SHOW PANEL
    --====================================================

    hideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        panelVisible = false
        mainFrame.Visible = false
        showButton.Visible = true
    end)

    local showDragged = false

    showButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        if showDragged then
            return
        end

        panelVisible = true
        mainFrame.Visible = true
        showButton.Visible = false
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- DRAG FLOATING SHOW BUTTON
    --====================================================

    local showDragStart
    local showStartPosition
    local showActiveInput

    showButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            showActiveInput = input
            showDragStart = input.Position
            showStartPosition = showButton.Position
            showDragged = false
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled
            or not showDragStart
            or not showStartPosition then
            return
        end

        local isMouseMove =
            showActiveInput
            and showActiveInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

        local isTouchMove =
            showActiveInput
            and showActiveInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == showActiveInput

        if isMouseMove or isTouchMove then
            local delta = input.Position - showDragStart

            if delta.Magnitude > 5 then
                showDragged = true
            end

            showButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                showStartPosition.X.Scale,
                showStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                showStartPosition.Y.Scale,
                showStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if showActiveInput and (
            input == showActiveInput
            or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        ) then
            showDragStart = nil
            showActiveInput = nil

            if showDragged then
                task.delay(0.2, function()
                    showDragged = false
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- DRAG MAIN PANEL WITH MOUSE OR TOUCH
    --====================================================

    local dragStart
    local startPosition
    local activeInput

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            activeInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = mainFrame.Position
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled or not dragStart then
            return
        end

        local isMouseMove =
            activeInput
            and activeInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

        local isTouchMove =
            activeInput
            and activeInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == activeInput

        if isMouseMove or isTouchMove then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart

            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPosition.X.Scale,
                startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPosition.Y.Scale,
                startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if activeInput and (
            input == activeInput
            or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        ) then
            dragStart = nil
            activeInput = nil
        end
    end)

    refreshESPButton()
end

--========================================================
-- CHAT COMMAND: UNNO
--========================================================

local function onChatMessage(message)
    if string.upper(message) == "UNNO" then
        draggingEnabled = not draggingEnabled

        if draggingEnabled then
            setStatus("Panel dragging: ON")
        else
            setStatus("Panel dragging: LOCKED")
        end
    end
end

Player.Chatted:Connect(onChatMessage)

--========================================================
-- INITIALIZE
--========================================================

createUI()

updateESP()

espConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if espEnabled then
        updateESP()
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- CLEANUP
--========================================================

screenGui.Destroying:Connect(function()
    restoreAll()
    removeESP()

    if espConnection then
        espConnection:Disconnect()
        espConnection = nil
    end
end)

scripts.script:
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

getgenv().EspActive = getgenv().EspActive or false
getgenv().CurrentBind = getgenv().CurrentBind or Enum.KeyCode.F
local activeHighlights = {}
local folderConnection = nil
local isBinding = false

-- Очистка старых GUI при перезапуске
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SakuraEspGui") then CoreGui.SakuraEspGui:Destroy() end

-- СОЗДАНИЕ САКУРА GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "SakuraEspGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui

-- Главный фрейм (Тема Сакуры)
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 110)
frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 150)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 22, 28) -- Темно-вишневый/розовый
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = frame

-- Неоновый градиент Сакуры
local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(50, 25, 35)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(30, 15, 20))
})
gradient.Rotation = 45
gradient.Parent = frame

-- Заголовок с цветочком
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 182, 193) -- Светло-розовый (Сакура)
title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
title.TextSize = 13
title.Text = "🌸 SAKURA ESP 🌸"
title.Parent = frame

-- Кнопка Включения/Выключения
local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.33, 0)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleBtn.TextSize = 12
toggleBtn.Parent = frame

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
btnCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

-- Кнопка Бинда
local bindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
bindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 24)
bindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.67, 0)
bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 35, 45)
bindBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
bindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 210)
bindBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
bindBtn.TextSize = 11
bindBtn.Text = "Бинд: " .. getgenv().CurrentBind.Name
bindBtn.Parent = frame

local bindCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
bindCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
bindCorner.Parent = bindBtn


-- УЛЬТРА ОПТИМИЗИРОВАННАЯ ЛОГИКА ESP
local function clearAllESP()
    for figure, hl in pairs(activeHighlights) do
        if hl then hl:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(activeHighlights)
end

local function highlightFigure(figure)
    if not getgenv().EspActive or not figure or activeHighlights[figure] then return end
    if figure.Name == "Figure" or figure:IsA("Model") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)     -- Насыщенный розовый (цветок сакуры)
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.35
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)   -- Белый контур для четкости
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.Adornee = figure
        hl.Parent = CoreGui
        activeHighlights[figure] = hl
    end
end

-- Моментальный трекинг без задержек и циклов
local function scan()
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ChameleonOpponent")
    if not folder then return end

    if getgenv().EspActive then
        for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            highlightFigure(obj)
        end
        if not folderConnection then
            folderConnection = folder.ChildAdded:Connect(highlightFigure)
        end
    else
        clearAllESP()
        if folderConnection then
            folderConnection:Disconnect()
            folderConnection = nil
        end
    end
end

local function updateUI()
    if getgenv().EspActive then
        toggleBtn.Text = "ESP: ВКЛЮЧЕН"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(219, 112, 147) -- Розовый неон
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "ESP: ВЫКЛЮЧЕН"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 45, 55)    -- Тусклый вишневый
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 140, 150)
    end
end

local function toggleESP()
    getgenv().EspActive = not getgenv().EspActive
    scan()
    updateUI()
end

-- Слушаем появление папки, если раунд обновился (Оптимальный ивент вместо цикла)
workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child.Name == "ChameleonOpponent" and getgenv().EspActive then
        task.wait(0.05) -- Микро-пауза для инициализации папки игрой
        scan()
    end
end)

-- Хэндлеры кнопок интерфейса
toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(toggleESP)

bindBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    if isBinding then return end
    isBinding = true
    bindBtn.Text = "Нажмите клавишу..."
    bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 65)
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if isBinding then
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            getgenv().CurrentBind = input.KeyCode
            bindBtn.Text = "Бинд: " .. input.KeyCode.Name
            bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 35, 45)
            isBinding = false
        end
        return
    end
    if not gpe and input.KeyCode == getgenv().CurrentBind then
        toggleESP()
    end
end)

-- Инициализация при старте
scan()
updateUI()
